listings.description: Gorgeous New Construction in prestigious Colfax Meadows! Step into your Dream Home, from the Light Filled Open Floorplan to the Wide Planked Wood Floors. Sit Fireside in the spacious Formal Living Room with a Custom Accent Wall open to the large Formal Dining Room. Enjoy the Grand Gourmet Kitchen boasting Thermadore Stainless Steel Appliances and Stunning Quartz Countertops including an Island/Breakfast Bar, Butler's Pantry with Wine Fridge and large Walk-In Food Pantry. Kitchen is open to the generous Family Room that feature Double Pocket Sliding Doors leading you outside to your own Private Oasis with Pool, Spa, Turf Grass, Built in BBQ and plenty of Covered Outdoor Lounging for that perfect Indoor/Outdoor Entertaining. Retreat to the Luxurious Primary Bedroom with Vaulted Ceilings and Detailed Beam, Separate Sitting Nook, Fireplace, Two Spacious Walk-In Closets, a Large Balcony overlooking the Backyard and Views of the Studio City Hills. Fabulous Bathroom featuring Dual Sinks, Spa Shower and Soaking Tub. Every Bedroom is Ensuite! One bedroom down and four bedrooms up. This home offers multiple Bonus Rooms such as a Home Movie Theatre, Upstairs Landing Lounge, Exercise Room off the Primary Bedroom, and an Office with beautiful Built-ins. Smart Home, Alarm, Cameras and Speakers throughout. Close to Tujunga Village, Farmers Market or Sushi Row on Ventura Blvd. Carpenter Charter Elementary!

Contemporary home, with modern amenities and finishes, is nestled in the prestigious Royal Woods neighborhood of Sherman Oaks hills. The expansive open floor plan of 4041 sq ft offers an inviting atmosphere of 'quiet luxury' living and well appointed 4 bedrooms, 4.5 baths. Desired California indoor-outdoor lifestyle setting with sparkling pool, with a background of lush mature plantings, stepping stones that enhance the back yard, complete with a custom built architectural metal pergola, great place for gatherings and relaxation. From the double door entry you step into the voluminous living space designed to seamlessly connect the living, dining and kitchen areas with a harmonious flow, and are greeted by the neutral palette and wide plank flooring throughout. The living room is spacious with fireplace and tall windows to allow a flood of light in, anchored by a beautiful custom built book case. The kitchen is truly a chef's kitchen and the heart of the home, with a supersized island complete with a breakfast bar, quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, multitude of cabinets, large pantry, and windows looking out to the inviting back yard. Adjacent, is the dining area with doors leading into the patio, and the comfortable family room with an accent wall suitable for art display. Located on the first floor are 3 generously sized bedrooms which are all ensuite with large bathrooms for privacy and comfort. Downstairs, the original main ensuite bedroom, with access to the patio, features a gorgeous spa like bathroom with walk in shower, dual vanity and soaking tub. Upstairs is the private king size primary ensuite bedroom retreat, addition completed in 2008, offers a sizable walk in closet, a balcony to enjoy views of the canyon and hills, features a luxurious spa like bathroom with dual vanity, large shower and soaking tub. Attached garage with finished walls has been fitted with EV charger. Conveniently situated with easy access to Ventura Blvd & the West Side, close to The Galleria, dining, shopping and more, this home is a must see. Listed by Beatrice Stambulski & Michael Bergin

Contemporary Spanish boasts a great open floor plan and has been tastefully remodeled in 2008 with an extra bonus room for an office or gym which goes out to a private quiet patio. Granite cook's kitchen with stainless steel appliances for entertaining. Master suite has a great master bath and master closet which feels like a hotel getaway. This master suite is very unique and complimented by many. Carpenter school district and walking distance to eat, shop and play at the Tujunga village.

Encompassing approximately 17,700 square feet, with an additional subterranean garage of roughly 9,500 square feet, the residence offers a volume and architectural envelope seldom found along the California coastline. Constructed prior to today's far more restrictive coastal regulations and height limitations, the estate possesses a level of scale, presence, and spatial grandeur that would be extraordinarily difficult, if not impossible, to duplicate today. Ownership includes coveted Riviera III Beach Key access, providing entry to one of Point Dume's most sought-after stretches of coastline. Grand yet inviting, the interiors are defined by soaring ceilings, expansive entertaining spaces, and walls of glass that frame sweeping ocean vistas from nearly every principal room. The home's remarkable proportions create an exceptional sense of openness while providing a rare opportunity for a future owner to reimagine, refine, or transform the residence according to their own vision. The scale and infrastructure already in place offer a foundation capable of accommodating virtually any design direction or lifestyle concept. Outside, a series of expansive terraces unfold toward the Pacific, creating an unparalleled setting for entertaining and everyday living alike. A resort-caliber pool and spa overlook the ocean, while multiple gathering areas, mature landscaping, and curated outdoor environments take full advantage of the property's commanding blufftop setting. A defining architectural feature of the estate is its dramatic oceanfront pavilion. Positioned at the edge of the property and framed by classical columns against an endless horizon, it serves as both a striking visual landmark and an unforgettable venue for entertaining above the water. Beyond its beauty, what distinguishes this offering is its rarity. Opportunities to acquire an oceanfront estate of this scale, with this degree of privacy, land, volume, and existing entitlements, have become increasingly scarce. More than a residence, it is a legacy property, one whose size, stature, Riviera III Beach Key access, and relationship to the coastline represent an asset unlikely to be replicated for generations to come.

listings.description: Set on approximately 1.6 acres along one of Malibu's most coveted stretches of Pacific Coast Highway, this newly reimagined coastal estate pairs breathtaking ocean views with exceptional design, resort-caliber amenities, and remarkable privacy. Encompassing approximately 15,430 square feet across a grand main residence, detached guest casita, staff accommodations, and ancillary structures, the property unfolds as a private compound immersed in mature landscaping and panoramic Pacific vistas.Completely redesigned by Luno Design Studio with sophisticated interiors by ATRAFORM, the estate blends timeless architecture with a refined contemporary sensibility. Expansive glass walls, soaring ceilings, elegant archways, and beautifully curated materials create a seamless connection between the interiors and the spectacular coastal setting beyond. Throughout the home, bespoke finishes, integrated smart home technology, and thoughtfully designed living spaces reflect a commitment to both beauty and functionality.The approximately 12,800-square-foot main residence offers four bedrooms, five full baths, and three powder rooms, with a series of formal and informal living spaces designed for both grand-scale entertaining and everyday comfort. Multiple fireplaces anchor the home's principal gathering spaces and private suites, while walls of glass frame uninterrupted ocean views from nearly every vantage point.Resort-inspired amenities are thoughtfully integrated throughout the estate. A pool overlooking the Pacific, championship tennis court with viewing pavilion, temperature-controlled wine cellar, billiards lounge with custom bar, substantial walk-in safe, expansive lawns, and beautifully landscaped gardens create an environment that rivals the world's finest private retreats. Ocean-facing terraces and outdoor entertaining spaces provide a spectacular setting for gatherings of any scale.Complementing the main residence is a detached one-bedroom guest casita, two additional guest or staff suites above the garage, dedicated staff accommodations, and extensive infrastructure including a Savant home automation system and 60kW backup generator.Minutes from Malibu's most celebrated beaches, dining destinations, and recreational offerings, this exceptional estate represents a rare opportunity to acquire a fully transformed coastal compound where architectural sophistication, privacy, and extraordinary ocean views converge.

listings.description: An exceptionally rare double-lot compound in Trousdale Estates, comprising two side-by-side residences seamlessly connected across two oversized flag lots totaling approximately 50,000 square feet. Privately positioned at the end of a quiet cul-de-sac on one of Trousdale's most coveted streets, the property offers extraordinary scale, privacy, architecture, and unobstructed city-to-ocean views. The striking contemporary main residence, designed by Scott Johnson with interiors by Waldo Fernandez, features dramatic walls of glass opening to expansive grounds and a spectacular 60-foot infinity pool. The three-bedroom, five-bath residence includes a theater, spa, private office, and beautifully appointed interiors throughout. The adjoining guest residence has been fully renovated and features four bedrooms and five bathrooms, with interiors also by Waldo Fernandez and a complementary exterior facade by Johnson Fain, creating a cohesive architectural experience across the compound. The grounds are thoughtfully landscaped, with plans for a designed and approved garden pavilion by RIOS, further enhancing the estate's exceptional indoor-outdoor setting. Impeccably furnished and conceived with extraordinary attention to detail, this one-of-a-kind Trousdale compound represents a rare opportunity to own nearly 50,000 square feet of contiguous land with two residences in one of Beverly Hills' most sought-after enclaves.

listings.description: Crowning the top of Hillcrest Road, the Trousdale Estates street many call Beverly Hills' Billionaire's Row, this approximately 22,300-square-foot estate sits on nearly one acre with panoramic views sweeping from Downtown Los Angeles to the Pacific Ocean. Built by renowned developer Bruce Makowsky, the residence spans two expansive levels connected by a private elevator, with 8 bedrooms and 15 bathrooms. The primary suite is a retreat of its own, with city-light views from the bed and a private pool overlooking the Los Angeles basin. The current owner has elevated the estate into a true entertainment destination, adding a multimillion-dollar professional recording studio with a separate drum room, along with a fully built private nightclub featuring a professional DJ booth, dance floor, bar, custom lighting, and a club-grade sound system. From intimate gatherings to full-scale celebrations, the experience never requires leaving home. Further enhancements include renovated lower-level bathrooms and a dedicated on-site security office, complemented by staff quarters for discretion and support at every level. A wine cellar completes the offering. Meticulously maintained throughout and available furnished or unfurnished, this is a rare opportunity to own a landmark residence at one of Beverly Hills' most celebrated addresses.

listings.description: Poised high atop a promontory, this palatial European Estate boasts jaw-dropping 360 degree views of all of Los Angeles. Rich in privacy behind gates and up the long tree-lined driveway, this fortress of unparalleled magnitude is revealed. Situated in a world of its own overlooking the stunning gardens and city, this home is the epitome of royal living in the most sought-after city in the country. High ceilings, ornate details and grand-scale rooms are showcased beyond the luxurious foyer and Imperial Staircase through the massive double door entrance. Highlights from the main floor include an industrial grade chef's kitchen with an adjacent light and bright breakfast room, a formal dining room with double doors made with Venetian stained glass windows, an impressive living room with a gorgeous bar and fireplace, a billiards room, and a formal sitting room. Among the many jewels of this home is the two story library which includes a steel spiral staircase and a vibrant irreplaceable stained glass light fixture. Upstairs, the master bedroom rivals that of a European castle with multiple private terraces, city and nature views, his and hers closets, a massage room and a luxurious bathroom made with lapis stone. In addition to the master suite there are four oversized en suite bedrooms each with beautiful views and walk in closets. The lower level is an entertainer's paradise with a theater, ballroom that opens up to a sprawling terrace where your guests can soak in the picturesque views, and a wine cellar that's authentically outfitted as the storefront of an early 18th century English saloon. The backyard consists of a sparkling pool and spa, outdoor kitchen, putting green, a fruit and vegetable garden, tennis court, koi pond, and endless places for dining al fresco. In addition to the various amenities, the home is also equipped with an oversized gym. This tranquil oasis is quintessential to the highest class of luxury living, built for those who hold history, design, and beauty in the highest regard.

listings.description: Set within the prestigious and exceptionally exclusive enclave of North Beverly Park, one of Los Angeles' most coveted and ultra-secure communities, this extraordinary Transitional-style estate spans approximately 2.68 acres of remarkably private grounds and commands sweeping vistas extending from the glittering city skyline to the Pacific Ocean beyond. Having undergone a complete gut remodel, the residence was masterfully conceived by the renowned team of Harrison Design, Paradigm Developers, and Mike Moser Studio, representing a remarkable achievement in architecture, craftsmanship, and timeless design. Encompassing nine bedrooms and twenty-two bathrooms, the estate offers a level of scale and luxury rarely encountered. A monumental pivot entry door welcomes guests into a spectacular grand foyer, where dual sweeping staircases elegantly frame the sitting room beyond and draw the eye to the breathtaking views that unfold through walls of glass. Defined by soaring scale and refined elegance, the interiors balance impressive volume with a warm and inviting atmosphere designed for everyday luxury. Floor-to-ceiling glass doors blur the line between indoors and out, revealing expansive terraces and picturesque grounds that lend themselves beautifully to both private moments and grand events. A spectacular 18-person formal dining room, surrounded by walls of sliding glass, creates an unforgettable dining experience with an ambiance reminiscent of the world's finest restaurants. Designed as a private sanctuary, the approximately 5,000-square-foot primary suite offers an unrivaled retreat complete with dual baths, an extensive multi-room wardrobe, massage room, glam room and salon, dry sauna, and a separate entrance for the utmost privacy and discretion. Enhancing the residence further are a sophisticated executive office, state-of-the-art screening room, extensive health and wellness amenities, and two kitchens, including a secondary commercial-grade chef's kitchen. The resort-inspired grounds are equally impressive, highlighted by a spectacular approximately 85-foot pool and spa, outdoor kitchen, expansive lawns, and a flourishing orchard of fruit trees. Eight hand-selected 100-year-old olive trees lend a timeless Mediterranean character to the landscape. Thoughtfully designed for year-round enjoyment, the outdoor amenities include two fire pit seating areas and a heated loggia with fireplaces anchoring each end, creating an inviting setting for both intimate gatherings and grand-scale entertaining. The estate offers a rare sense of serenity and seclusion while remaining ideally suited for everyday living and exceptional events. A true legacy property and one of the most distinguished offerings in Beverly Park. Also available separately is the adjacent vacant parcel at 74 Beverly Park Lane. Acquired together, the two properties present an exceptionally rare opportunity to create a magnificent private compound encompassing approximately 4.89 acres, creating one of the most significant residential holdings within Beverly Park.

listings.description: Villa Vista is an exceptionally private, nearly new owner-built estate perched on a rare 2.63-acre promontory. Offering unparalleled privacy and commanding views, this extraordinary property has it all. Upon entering through the gated entry and expansive motor court (with parking for up to 35 cars), the dramatic front door frames a breathtaking head-on panorama stretching from Downtown Los Angeles to the Pacific Ocean, encompassing the iconic estates of Beverly Hills, Bel Air, and Holmby Hills. The estate boasts an impressive array of amenities, including an infinity edge swimming pool with sweeping views, a separate spa and fire pit, a lighted tennis court, lush gardens, and mature fruit trees. Additional highlights include a professional Dolby Atmos theater with a Kaleidescape system, a 600+ bottle wine cellar, a custom elevator, and a luxurious primary suite featuring a sitting room and dual independent bathrooms. More than 7,000 square feet of outdoor terraces and dining areas take full advantage of the spectacular daytime and glittering nighttime views. In addition to five guest bedrooms, the home offers a beauty salon, massage room, and a fully equipped gymnasium with panoramic views. Custom-designed and fabricated steel doors open effortlessly throughout, complemented by white oak floors and a striking limestone fireplace. A Daikin 23-zone HVAC system provides individual climate control for virtually every area of the residence. The Bulthaup-designed kitchen, featuring premium Gaggenau appliances, seamlessly opens to the breakfast room and family room. Located off Lower Benedict Canyon, Villa Vista offers remarkable proximity to downtown Beverly Hills while remaining completely removed from any neighbors. There is no substitute for Villa Vista.

listings.description: Picturesque Mediterranean Revival compound that emulates old Hollywood while offering every modern amenity today's most discerning buyer requires. Breathtaking panoramic city views, paired with fortress-like privacy, all in a coveted lower Benedict Canyon setting just minutes from world-class shopping and dining. Designed by architect Kevin Clark and completed in 2011 after seven years of meticulous construction, the estate centers on a main residence, a guest house, and separate staff quarters. Bold interior elements, arches, coffered ceilings, and architectural elements run throughout. Double-height vestibules, vast imported stone fireplaces, formal living rooms, a color-drenched study with a heavily decorated ceiling, and a bank of arched French windows/doors truly set this property apart. A chef-grade kitchen with Wolf/Miele appliances, butlers pantry, and informal dining room opens to a stunning outdoor patio with calming fountains. Intricate herringbone brick stairwell descends to a notable wine cellar, while all rooms feature standout scale and seamless flow across the impressive 16,079 sf floor plan. Expansive primary retreat with large sitting lounge, separate his and her bathrooms and oversized showcase wardrobe rooms. Manicured gardens, a championship-caliber clay tennis court with entertainment pavilion, and a pool overlooking the city below complete the grounds.The quality of construction, detail, and finishes cannot be overstated; grand stone columns flank the entrance, and period-style quoins add grandeur at every turn of the exterior.A multi-car motor court and top-rate amenities make for a highly revered residence within an enviable Beverly Hills location.

listings.description: Spectacular Paradise Cove beachfront compound located on the sand in one of the most exclusive gated enclaves in the world, offering stunning blue-water views up and down the coast. With approximately 90 feet of beach frontage, this estate is not on the bluffs or merely ocean-view like others in the community that have sold in the $90 - $200 million range - it is truly oceanfront. A separate, fully self-contained second home/large cabana sits directly on the sand. A rare and expansive entertaining patio is also positioned right on the beach, along with a large rooftop deck atop the cabana - perfect for hosting gatherings and events on and in the water. The spacious, light-filled main home features four bedrooms, including dual primary suites, and a vast kitchen/dining/family great room with soaring ceilings, skylights, a fireplace, wraparound windows, and decks for lounging and seamless indoor/outdoor entertaining - all opening to the ocean and panoramic coastal views. listings.description: WSJ EXCLUSIVE: One of the most highly anticipated projects to come to market in the history of the city, this magnificent entertainer's showplace is a palatial masterpiece, envisioned and executed by highly acclaimed designer and developer to the elite Ramtin Ray Nosrati. Custom European furnishings are included with purchase, near the world-famous Beverly Hills Hotel, the fabulous high fashion of Rodeo Drive, and many reasons that make Los Angeles a global destination: Surrounded by some of the most expensive homes in the world, OPAL represents not only the next phase of architectural progression but a thought-forward reimagining of what true luxury means in the modern era, using the most rare, unseen materials. One of the most impressive attributes of its owner's wing is a department store-eclipsing wardrobe, one of the largest residential closets ever permitted in Los Angeles! Positioned behind a fortress-like enclosure, this ultra-private contemporary chateau is adorned with verdant beauty and set amidst lush ficus, legacy olive trees, and palms with a vast motor court for up to twelve vehicles. Cascading waterfalls shimmer and flow into moat-inspired waters surrounding a grand approach. Towering panes of glass and iron form the main entry and frame dazzling views of downtown LA and its unmistakable skyline plus incredible vistas of the Pacific Ocean. In the double-height foyer, sparkling globes of light hang overhead, welcoming visitors into the resort-like paradise with lofty ceilings and unbelievable views from every room. Proceed across a bridge path past a colossal handmade rock mountain wall and 26-foot tree art installation to enter the sprawling great room, with DTLA the visual centerpiece. A giant limestone fireplace segments two floor-to-ceiling letterbox openings through which revelers pass for maximum indoor-outdoor celebration. Coffered ceilings carry the eyes to the two-story dining room with statement bookcase shelving, 24-foot ceilings, and skylights carrying natural sunlight over its limewashed walls and organic accents. Aside a cushy breakfast nook, the gorgeous kitchen continues the estate's travertine theme, with custom appliances and oversized block island. To the rear, discover a catering kitchen, complete with a double-size walk-in commercial refrigerator. The family room, also with a commanding fireplace and iron-paned floor-to-ceiling windows, is highlighted by a Brazilian "Tiffany" stone wet bar with live-edge slabs and teal veining. A sightseeing elevator with viewing window connects all levels. Ascend the swirling wooden floating staircase to the lavish primary suite with herringbone floors, viewing deck, espresso bar, and double hidden doors that access a sauna and spa-like bath and changing areas. Bookmatched stone encases the triple-size rainwater shower with soaking tub and ledge, and a giant dual-sink island vanity affords an abundance of personal, private space. On the amenity-rich leisure level, a dramatic temperature-controlled glass wine tasting room is larger than most dining rooms, and one of the most beautiful movie theatres to date includes a celestial ceiling and snack bar. Billiards and card areas are positioned beneath viewing windows to the eyebrow-shaped glass-bottom pool with Baja shelves above, just one of two infinity pools found in the backyard terraces. There is also a wellness gym, two reading nooks, and a media section with a nine-screen video wall capable of screening multiple channels and streams at once. On the rooftop, surrounded by striking 360-degree vistas of the ocean, city, mountains, and ridgeline, enjoy a friendly game of pickleball, dine al-fresco, or gather around one of numerous fire tables placed throughout the stone-clad palace. The main-level barbecue cabana is equipped with a pizza oven, wet bar, serving ledge, and 116-inch television. A massive garage houses up to eight cars. The next iteration of opulence has finally arrived and a new bar is raised.

listings.description: Behind the double gates of The Estates at The Oaks, this majestic residence offers rare privacy and sweeping, unobstructed views across the rolling hills of Malibu. Set at the end of a long, quiet driveway, and spanning over two acres, the property evokes a European country estate, thoughtfully built over more than a decade with exceptional care and intention. Traditional craftsmanship is showcased through hand-selected stone, custom wall treatments, intricate moldings, and layered tile work, with bespoke wallpaper, paneling, and millwork sourced from JP Weaver Company. The architecture feels timeless yet current, anchored by a grand arrival court with a scaled stone fountain and an entry aligned perfectly with the horizon. Inside, soaring domed ceilings, wide hallways, and sweeping bronze staircases frame endless vistas and create a striking sense of arrival. The main level unfolds through a seamless blend of formal and informal spaces. A monumental entry leads to an elegant lounge with a Spanish limestone fireplace opening to the gardens, while a Louis XIV inspired dining room with custom French wall coverings overlooks the grounds. The chef's kitchen flows into the family room, bar, and fireside gathering areas, finished with refined European details and a full suite of Miele and Wolf appliances. Dual library offices with concealed bath and Minotti cabinetry, a vaulted game room opening to outdoor entertaining areas, three guest suites with outdoor access, and a glass-wrapped gym with steam room and massage suite complete the level. Wraparound terraces extend the living spaces outdoors, ideal for both entertaining and quiet retreat. Upstairs, five bedroom suites surround a grand landing, including an exceptional primary suite with vaulted ceilings, a private living room, domed office, dual spa-caliber bathrooms, expansive closets, and a sweeping terrace with outdoor fireplace overlooking Malibu State Park. A secondary primary offers similar scale with its own foyer, stone fireplace, soaking tub, and private terrace. The lower level features a 5,225 sq. ft. air-conditioned garage, a French-inspired cinema with fiber-optic ceiling and Dolby Atmos sound, an entertaining lounge with bar, wine cellar and tasting room, and a private beauty salon. The grounds unfold as a series of curated experiences, including tennis, pickleball, and bocce courts, a solar-heated ozone pool, dramatic fire pits, and a fully equipped outdoor pavilion with dual BBQs, pizza oven, bar, and integrated bathrooms. A vegetable garden adds a quieter rhythm to the property. Above it all, an elevator-accessed rooftop deck offers uninterrupted 360-degree views across the entire community. The estate is engineered for longevity and sustainability with advanced HVAC, whole-home water purification, solar power, fire-resistant construction, a full backup generator, and a triple-phase electrical system guided by Vastu and feng shui principles for balance and clarity.

listings.description: Set on a dramatic bluff of only 14 homes overlooking the Pacific, this extraordinary gated estate offers breathtaking, panoramic views stretching along the Southern California coastline. Spanning over 1.6 acres on a rare street-to-street lot from Pacific Coast Highway to Malibu Road, the property is composed of three Balinese-inspired pavilions arranged in a U-shape around stepped terraces, tranquil courtyard gardens, and reflecting pools. A palm-lined driveway leads to a grand motor court and four-car garage, while limestone-clad exteriors, teak doors and windows, and custom-designed gates adorned with Chinese green-ware tiles create a striking architectural statement. The magnificent inner courtyard framed by palms and shimmering water features seamlessly blurs the line between indoor and outdoor living. Originally built in 2016, and designed by renowned designer Martyn Lawrence Bullard, the home is a masterful blend of global artistry and refined coastal elegance. The soaring great room, anchored by fireplaces crafted from 17th- and 18th-century Indian columns, opens through 30-foot sliding glass doors to expansive ocean-view terraces. Hand-stenciled walls, antique architectural elements from Java and Rajasthan and curated furnishings create richly layered interiors that feel both collected and timeless. listings.description: Experience this completely reimagined contemporary residence, where sophisticated design, refined finishes, and breathtaking city and canyon views come together in the hills of prime Studio City. Defined by meticulous craftsmanship, bespoke finishes, and an exceptional collection of amenities, this 4BD/4.5BA smart home delivers an elevated indoor-outdoor lifestyle complete with a fully equipped gym, serene spa room, library, and resort-style backyard. A gated driveway framed by mature landscaping leads to a sleek entry, where white oak flooring and a sculptural spiral staircase establish an immediate sense of warmth and luxury. The entry level offers a two-car garage with direct access, a fully finished gym, and a tranquil spa room that can also serve as a creative studio. The spiral staircase ascends to the main living level, where a dramatic living room framed by expansive glass windows captures sweeping city views. Adjacent, a light-filled library and office features custom floor-to-ceiling shelving with a rolling ladder, creating an inspiring setting for working from home. Designed for entertaining, the formal dining room is anchored by a bespoke bar and opens through sliding doors to a private balcony overlooking panoramic vistas. The adjoining kitchen is appointed with a Gaggenau cooktop, stainless steel Dacor smart refrigerator, double Wolf ovens, custom oak cabinetry, Eco Outdoor limestone flooring, and a dumbwaiter lift. A walk-in pantry with a Miele wine refrigerator provides additional storage. The expansive Tiffany Quartzite island, illuminated by dramatic skylights, carries seamlessly onto the backsplash, which conceals a custom spice rack for a clean, tailored aesthetic. The kitchen flows effortlessly into the family room, where floor-to-ceiling sliders open directly to the private backyard. A statement powder room finished in Calacatta Viola marble, along with a thoughtfully designed laundry room featuring dual stacked LG washer/dryers, a deep sink, and abundant storage, completes the main level. A short flight of stairs leads to the spectacular primary suite, positioned to capture sweeping views across the city and canyon. This private retreat features an oversized dual walk-in closet with a dedicated laundry chute, a private balcony, sitting room, and an additional lounge connecting the secondary bedroom suites. The primary bath evokes a private sanctuary with limestone floors, Calacatta Viola stone, a nature-inspired shower beneath a skylight, soaking tub, dual vanity, and dedicated water closet. Three additional bedrooms each offer generous walk-in closets and beautifully appointed ensuite baths with designer finishes. Outside, the resort-style grounds unfold against a dramatic city and canyon backdrop, with a sparkling pool and spa, expansive lawn, firepit, and outdoor kitchen equipped with a built-in grill and mini refrigerator, creating an exceptional setting for both intimate gatherings and large-scale entertaining. Ideally situated within the highly regarded Carpenter School District and moments from Studio City's acclaimed dining, boutique shopping, and Fryman Canyon trails, this exceptional property offers a rare combination of architectural polish, resort-inspired amenities, and panoramic views.

listings.description: Every great neighborhood has that one special street. The one people talk about. The one people wait for. Welcome to 112 South Valley, a newly constructed, modern masterpiece that redefines luxury living. Perfectly positioned on one of Burbank's most coveted cul-de-sacs, this home offers the best of both worlds: the peace of mind that comes with Burbank's exceptional city services, outstanding public safety, and top-rated schools, paired with the prestige, warmth, and community charm of Toluca Lake. The designer thoughtfully curated every detail of this 6,043-square-foot residence to showcase architectural brilliance and deliver the soul-stirring promise of a life well lived. From the moment you arrive, the dramatic, solid white oak pivot front door opens to a world of refined elegance. Soaring ceilings and walls of Marvin windows flood the space with natural light, while rich textures, such as Marmorino Italian plaster and Portolan limewash, create an ambiance of sophistication. Whether you're gathering in the expansive living room, relaxing in the family room, or entertaining in the chef's kitchen adorned with custom Shinnoki walnut cabinetry, an oversized double-faucet sink, Thermador appliances, and a sleek butler's pantry, this home is an experience of flow, function, and flawless beauty. Four en-suite bedrooms, each a private retreat, offer comfort and serenity. The primary suite, situated above the expansive landscaped grounds, features a spa-inspired bath, a custom walnut walk-in closet, and a balcony where you can greet the day with sunshine and the soothing sounds of the morning air. Downstairs, a state-of-the-art theater, rec room, bonus space, and a sleek bar come together to create the ultimate setting for fun and entertainment, whether you're hosting game night, enjoying a movie with family, or simply unwinding with friends in style. Step outside and be transported. The backyard is a sanctuary of its own, featuring a black-bottom saltwater Pebble Tek pool with a Baja shelf and spa, two innovative motorized patio systems, an Ipe wood fire pit bench, and a complete outdoor bath/mudroom. Entertain effortlessly or unwind in total privacy beneath the stars. The home offers the latest in technology and convenience, featuring Control4 smart home automation, a quad-zone Carrier climate control system, an integrated sound system, custom lighting, and sleek Samsung washer/dryers. Additional amenities include fully underground electrical, solar panels for enhanced energy efficiency, and an electric car charger in the spacious garage. Every element from fluted limestone accents to custom linear drain installations reflects the highest standards of design and craftsmanship. However, the true luxury of 112 South Valley lies in the lifestyle it offers. Here, neighbors greet each other by name. Stroll into Toluca Village for your morning coffee, dine al fresco at your favorite local spot, or attend a community event where everyone feels like family. You're minutes from top-rated schools, major studios, the Lakeside Golf Club, and iconic LA landmarks like Griffith Park and the Hollywood Bowl. 112 South Valley is more than a home; it's your place in a vibrant, welcoming community with a rare opportunity to live in modern splendor, in a neighborhood where connection and character matter.

listings.description: Presenting the Van Dekker House, 1940, built by renowned master architect R. M. Schindler and recognized by LA city as Historic-Cultural Monument No. 974. Studying firsthand under Frank Lloyd Wright, Schindler's prolific work has defined Modern architecture in Southern California. This gated compound is Schindler's largest known residential project, spanning approx. 4,000 SF under roof & situated on a half acre of sprawling manicured grounds. Steeped in Hollywood history, the Van Dekker House was commissioned for actor Albert Van Dekker, sold to screenwriter Al "Buzz," & frequented by the likes of Humphrey Bogart, Robert Mitchum, & William Faulkner. The property has been meticulously restored with the intent of reinvigorating Schindler's iconic design elements while also introducing contemporary amenities. Interiors are highlighted by soaring wood beamed angled ceilings with glass panels & clerestory windows that invite natural light to create a cacophony of reflections. An oversized great room has majestic mountain/Valley views, stone & copper statement fireplace & direct access to the exteriors. Updated kitchen features custom cabinetry, Bosch appliances, & access to the formal dining room. Additional living spaces include billiard/games room with wine cellar, den/office, & sitting room. All four bedrooms have en-suite bathrooms & built-in closets. Top floor primary suite overlooks panoramic Valley views with private gym & remodeled bathroom with dual sinks & walk-in shower. Throughout the residence you'll find Schindler's signature built-in custom furniture, natural stone & wood materials, & several outdoor patio decks that provide incredible indoor/outdoor flow. The expansive grounds allow for grand scale entertaining featuring salt water pool with swim jets, waterfall spa, wood deck with fire pit, mature landscaping with turf lawn, & sweeping driveway that leads to parking for 8 cars. A 256 SF detached office has second kitchen & laundry. All major systems have been upgraded including the rehabilitation of Schindler's striking asymmetrical, copper-paneled roof. Solar panels & greywater/rainwater catchment systems have been added. The home also comes with a Mills Act contract for a significant tax incentive. Buyer to verify. Adjacent to terrific dining/shopping, Westfield Topanga Mall/Village, Warner Center/Rams Development, parks/hiking trails, & easy access to the beach/freeways. Rare opportunity to own a piece of art in this Schindler legacy estate.

listings.description: Welcome to the finest of what ranch life has to offer! Nestled against the Angeles National Forest on 155 gorgeous acres and a close drive from both Santa Clarita and the Antelope Valley, this extraordinary property offers an unparalleled blend of luxury living, natural beauty, and all the infrastructure and amenities needed to facilitate rural living. The Residence: A magnificent 4-bedroom, 4-bathroom custom home spanning an impressive 4,938 square feet is the crown jewel of the property. Built and maintained with meticulous attention to detail, the residence seamlessly marries spaciousness with comfort and includes features such as: - Grand living spaces with soaring ceilings and incredible views of Soledad Canyon's natural beauty. - A Gourmet Kitchen featuring custom cabinet work, stainless steel appliances, and plentiful amounts of storage and counter space. - Massive primary suite complete with dual closets, fireplace, as well as an enormous bathroom that includes both a shower and jacuzzi tub, and dual sinks. - 3 generously sized bedrooms and attached bathrooms ensure ultimate privacy and comfort for family and guests alike. - Upstairs game room/TV room with windows showcasing the gorgeous views to the front of the house. This is more than just a home; it's a legacy property where luxury meets self-sufficiency in a private setting. Schedule your private tour today to experience this incredible property in person!

listings.description: An exceptional opportunity to own approximately 68 private acres in Los Angeles County, combining cinematic history, substantial infrastructure, panoramic views, and a distinctive Southern California setting. Located along Soledad Canyon in Acton, this legacy ranch borders the Angeles National Forest, with the San Gabriel Mountains to the south and views extending north toward Parker Mountain. Along this stretch, the canyon runs east to west, creating an expansive setting framed by dramatic mountain landscapes. Mature palms, sculptural cacti, native manzanita, chaparral, yucca, maguey, and other high-desert plantings give the grounds a rich and unmistakable California character. A historic gold mine adds a rare connection to the region's past, while the acreage and surrounding natural landscape offer a remarkable sense of privacy and seclusion. The property has served as the backdrop for feature films, television productions, and national commercial campaigns, and continues to be actively scouted for future projects. An established internal road network, three dedicated parking areas, and extensive production infrastructure have accommodated large-scale productions. A location manager familiar with the property is available upon request. Significant capital improvements distinguish this offering, including a reported investment exceeding $500,000 in electrical and utility infrastructure. Improvements include new utility poles and transformers, fire-protection improvements to the electrical infrastructure, a new permitted main electrical service, and electrical distribution throughout the ranch. A 138-foot private well supplies a 10,000-gallon epoxy-coated steel storage tank, with approximately one mile of buried 2-inch PVC water lines delivering water to the residence, barns, and permitted structures throughout the property. Additional improvements include a 5,000-gallon septic system, upgraded copper water lines, insulated plumbing, new ABS waste lines, upgraded fencing and gates, and extensive structural enhancements. The existing residence, barns, and multiple permitted buildings provide flexibility for restoration, renovation, or reimagining, supported by infrastructure already distributed across the ranch. Whether envisioned as a future luxury estate, equestrian ranch, private retreat, family compound, filming location, wellness retreat, corporate getaway, or long-term investment, the property offers a range of possibilities to explore, subject to applicable zoning, permits, and approvals. Its combination of acreage, established production use, historic character, and substantial utility improvements makes this a distinctive offering for buyers seeking a property beyond the conventional residential estate. With its forest boundary, panoramic mountain vistas, and enduring connection to California's landscape and entertainment history, this legacy ranch presents an opportunity to shape its next chapter. Buyer to independently verify all information, including acreage, boundaries, access and easements, building permits, utility capacities, mineral rights, and suitability for intended uses, future development, or subdivision.

listings.description: Situated on a quiet tree-lined street in the coveted Footbridge Square neighborhood of Studio City, lies this custom-built home that redefines modern luxury living. The open-concept floor plan seamlessly blends style and function, featuring a gourmet chef's kitchen outfitted with top-of-the-line appliances, an oversized island, butler's pantry with walk-in storage and sun-drenched breakfast nook, which flows effortlessly into the spacious family room. Designed for elevated entertaining, the formal living and dining room is the perfect setting for intimate dinners or large-scale celebrations. There are five generously sized ensuite bedrooms, including one on the main level and a luxurious primary suite that offers dual walk-in closets and a sumptuous bathroom, complete with a soaking tub, stream shower and double vanity. Enveloped by mature privacy hedges, the backyard retreat invites year-round relaxation and entertaining with a heated pool and spa, built-in BBQ and firepit, and a covered patio with a cantilever umbrella. This home comes fully equipped with a Control4 smart home system that manages lighting, audio and cameras. Additional highlights include high ceilings throughout, a dedicated laundry room, state-of-the-art security system, wine storage and a two-car garage with EV charging. Located in the heart of Studio City within the top-rated Carpenter School District, this exceptional property is just moments away from Ventura Boulevard's trendy restaurants and boutique shops, the Studio City Farmers Market and so much more.

listings.description: Epitomizing California's relaxed luxury, this four-bedroom modern traditional home in white-hot Brookside, near Hancock Park, is filled with light, style, and sophisticated charm. The six stylish baths have quartz counters and designer fixtures; the spa-inspired en suite master bath includes a soaking tub and a glass-enclosed shower. Multi-zone air conditioning and an alarm system are among the modern amenities. A deck encourages alfresco entertaining or soaking up the sun beside the alluring pool and spa. A two-car garage completes the picture.

listings.description: Experience modern luxury living in the hills of Encino! team.name: Andrew Kline
bio: Whether you’re looking to buy or sell a home, Andrew Kline is an agent that can produce results. His reputation has been built on his unrelenting work ethic, honesty, and overall can-do attitude. He specializes in utilizing cutting-edge technology to consistently maximize exposure of properties through digital and traditional marketing, advertising, and social media.

Andrew was born in New York, but spent almost the entirety of his life in Los Angeles, and he is intimately familiar with the city and its surroundings. Prior to Real Estate, he spent time working in the world of high-end retail, managing and buying for Fred Segal in Melrose and Santa Monica. Driven by his entrepreneurial spirit, and armed with the knowledge that he gained in his previous role, Andrew opened the preeminent menswear boutique in Westlake Village: Tradition. He’s done all this while maintaining a long-standing career in the Music Business and traveling the world playing guitar in the seminal hardcore band, Strife.

Realizing the key to a successful transaction lies in the art of communication, Andrew takes a tremendous amount of pride in performing at the highest level for his clients and always making himself readily available to them. His professionalism, commitment, and attentiveness to detail will be sure to exceed all of your expectations.

team.name: Angie Degrazia Shaw
bio: Angie is originally from Chicago, Illinois. Her father was a successful city planner and environmental land developer. Angie watched and learned as he grew his business all the way to Arizona and she has been interested in real estate ever since. Angie obtained a Communications/Theater degree from the University of Arizona. She had the yearning to pursue acting in Los Angeles but soon after arriving in LA she started working as a makeup artist where she started her own business for 20 years at the same time earning many successes as an actor on various TV shows and commercials.

Her communication degree became very apparent when she purchased her first home in Sherman oaks which sparked her knack for pursuing Real Estate. Angie prides herself on being a Type A personality. She is loyal, patient, hard working and will immediately make you feel comfortable. She has fallen in love with real estate and is excited about helping you find your dream home in your perfect location! Angie is currently working alongside Michael Bergin, one of the top producing agents in Los Angeles.

team.name: Arshineh Olson
bio: Arshineh Olson is a passionate and savvy real estate agent who understands the logistics and emotions that go along with buying and selling property. As a homeowner and investor with short-term rentals herself, she understands that purchasing property is a big decision and strives to put her heart and soul into every transaction. Prior to venturing into real estate, Arshineh spent years as an Executive Assistant at Hulu in Santa Monica. Spending her days working alongside c-suite executives and managing their busy schedules, this unique experience has made her no stranger to client relationships, responsibility, and handling sensitive high-profile situations. This combination of uncompromising attention to detail and extensive knowledge of the real estate industry has proven to be an asset to her clients.

Arshineh is a part of the Bergin Group at Compass, a highly successful real estate team in LA, ranked withinin the city’s top 1% and with 15 years of experience. Running parallel to her real estate career is her family life. She is a passionate loving mother to two sweet girls and wife to a successful video editor in the film-marketing industry. Her vast network combines connections from her past work experiences, her large network of friends and family, as well as the support of countless real estate professionals in the industry. This synergy of experience and passion makes Arshineh the perfect real estate agent for anyone looking to buy or sell their next property

team.name: Brianna Korn
bio: With a deep-rooted connection to Hidden Hills and a profound knowledge of Los Angeles and Ventura counties, Brianna Korn is your real estate professional dedicated to making meaningful connections with her clients. Having spent her entire life in Los Angeles, Brianna has cultivated valuable relationships and gained a deep understanding of the local real estate market. From the Westside to Ventura, she knows the ins and outs of each neighborhood and can provide invaluable insights to her clients.

Brianna believes that real estate is more than just a transaction. It is about building relationships and helping clients achieve their goals. Her background as an Emergency Room nurse at Cedars Sinai has equipped her with the ability to understand her clients’ needs and guide them through the real estate process with ease. Her commitment to excellence has earned her a reputation for integrity, professionalism, and personalized service. Whether you are a first-time homebuyer or a seasoned investor, Brianna is committed to providing you with expert guidance and making your real estate experience as seamless as possible. Let her passion for real estate and her deep roots in the community help you find the perfect place to call home.

team.name: Erika Quicquaro
bio: Erika Quicquaro is a Southern California based Realtor with 15 years of experience in sales and hospitality. Erika specializes in providing excellent customer service, with the client experience being her primary concern. After getting her BA in Communication Studies and Wine & Viticulture at Cal Poly San Luis Obispo, Erika worked in leadership roles for a Fortune 500 company focusing on business strategy, pricing negotiations and project management. A natural passion for real estate and matching friends with their dream homes lead Erika to pursue being a Realtor full time and she was thrilled to join COMPASS and the incredible Bergin Group in 2022. Erika thrives in stressful situations where she can remain considerate and communicative in order to reach the desired outcome. In her spare time, Erika enjoys hiking, watching LA Sports, baking, and playing with her two rescue mutts Dodger and Tango.
Whether you’re looking to buy or sell, or just curious about the current real estate market, please don’t hesitate to get in touch with me by text, phone or email. I look forward to connecting!

team.name: Joy Bergin
bio: Joy Bergin is an accomplished marketing director at The Bergin Group, where she is responsible for overseeing the company’s marketing strategy and branding efforts. Prior to joining The Bergin Group, Joy was the co-founder of Hot Moms Club, a successful media company that she built from the ground up and eventually sold for a substantial profit. During her time at Hot Moms Club, Joy was able to amass an impressive following of over 6 million fans on Facebook, cementing her position as a social media marketing guru.

Before her foray into entrepreneurship, Joy spent over two decades in the film and television industry as a leading hair and Make -up artist. Working along side some of the top talent in the field has proven to be incredibly valuable in the Los Angeles market. This background has proven invaluable in her current position, where she uses her marketing expertise and creative vision to help The Bergin Group stand out in a crowded marketplace.

Despite her busy career, Joy remains committed to her family, and is a proud mother to two children. Her son, Jesse, is a talented pitcher for the Miami Marlins, while her daughter, Alana, who is both a model and a student attending San Diego State University. In her free time, Joy enjoys spending time with her family, traveling, and exploring new restaurants and cultural experiences right here in Los Angeles.

team.name: Mario Ortega
bio: Born and raised in California, there is no other place Mario would call home. Mario got his degree in pre-med with the hopes of becoming a cosmetic surgeon, but decided to turn his passion for interior design and real estate into a career. His skill set for creating elevated and luxurious interiors is a valuable asset to anyone looking to sell or buy a home. Mario has helped countless clients prepare their homes for sale, whether it’s decluttering and styling to full renovations to maximize the sales price and return on investment. Look at Mario as your Real Estate Designer and a “one-stop-shop” for ALL your real estate and home needs. Over the past several years, Mario’s precise attention to detail and eye for potential and value has allowed him to surround himself with a stable of highly skilled tradespeople to tackle any home project and turn any house into a future dream home. It is that very passion for design and real estate that Mario created Scented Memories Candle Company, a luxury candle company to add that finishing touch to any home with a bespoke and elegant scent that will always remind you of home.
Mario joined The Bergin Group in 2023 and the fit was like a glove. His expertise brings a unique facet to the group and he is excited to be part of The Bergin Group family.

In the very rare days Mario has time off, he enjoys spending time at home where he lives happily ever after with his partner Greg, a syndicated radio personality, and their baby girl Cali, an adorable pit bull.

communities.name: Beverly Hills
communities.description: Expert real estate services for SOCAL MLS | Michael Bergin is renowned for a multifaceted forte in working with sellers and buyers, whether it be new construction, home sales, short sales, finding your starter home or that perfect dream home.
body: Beverly Hills, California is a city located in the Los Angeles County in Southern California. It is known for its luxurious lifestyle, beautiful architecture, and high-end shopping destinations.

The city is home to some of the most opulent and extravagant homes and estates in the United States, and it is a popular destination for celebrities and affluent individuals. The famous Rodeo Drive, a three-block stretch of high-end designer stores and boutiques, is a mecca for luxury shopping enthusiasts.

Beverly Hills is also known for its beautiful tree-lined streets, manicured lawns, and beautiful parks. The city’s most famous park is the Beverly Hills Park, which offers stunning views of the Los Angeles skyline and features a variety of recreational facilities, including tennis courts, basketball courts, and picnic areas.

The city also has a vibrant cultural scene, with a variety of art galleries, museums, and theaters. The Wallis Annenberg Center for the Performing Arts is a popular venue for live performances, including theater productions and concerts.
Overall, Beverly Hills is a beautiful and sophisticated city that offers a luxurious lifestyle and a wide range of cultural and recreational activities.

communities.description: Expert real estate services for SOCAL MLS | Michael Bergin is renowned for a multifaceted forte in working with sellers and buyers, whether it be new construction, home sales, short sales, finding your starter home or that perfect dream home.
body: Brentwood is an upscale neighborhood located in the Westside region of Los Angeles, California, United States. It is situated between Santa Monica to the south and the Santa Monica Mountains to the north. The neighborhood covers an area of approximately 15 square miles and has a population of approximately 34,000 residents as of 2021.

Brentwood is known for its affluent and luxurious lifestyle, with many high-end shops, restaurants, and residential properties. The neighborhood is home to several celebrities and prominent figures in the entertainment industry. The area is also known for its excellent schools, including the highly-rated Brentwood School.

Brentwood is surrounded by natural beauty, with the Santa Monica Mountains providing a stunning backdrop. The area is also home to several parks and outdoor recreational areas, including the popular Will Rogers State Park, which offers hiking trails, picnic areas, and equestrian facilities.

The neighborhood is well-connected to other parts of Los Angeles, with easy access to major highways and public transportation options. It is a popular destination for both residents and visitors seeking a luxurious and upscale lifestyle in a beautiful and convenient location.

communities.name: Calabasas
body: Calabasas is a suburban city located in the San Fernando Valley region of Los Angeles County, California, United States. It is situated approximately 22 miles west of downtown Los Angeles and covers an area of approximately 13 square miles. The city has a population of approximately 25,000 residents as of 2021.

Calabasas is known for its affluent and luxurious lifestyle, with many high-end shops, restaurants, and residential properties. The area is home to several notable celebrities and prominent figures in the entertainment industry.

In addition to its luxurious lifestyle, Calabasas is also known for its natural beauty, with several parks and outdoor recreational areas located throughout the city. The nearby Santa Monica Mountains provide a scenic backdrop and offer excellent hiking and mountain biking opportunities.

Calabasas is also home to several cultural attractions, including the Leonis Adobe Museum, which offers a glimpse into California’s ranching history, and the Calabasas Commons, an outdoor shopping and entertainment complex that features live music and events.

Despite its reputation as an upscale and exclusive destination, Calabasas is a welcoming and friendly community that offers a relaxed and laid-back lifestyle. It is a popular destination for both visitors and residents seeking a luxurious suburban lifestyle in a beautiful and scenic location.

communities.name: Encino
communities.description: Enjoy the distinguished Encino lifestyle when you buy your dream home. Get in touch with agent Michael Bergin today to find homes for sale in Encino, CA.
body: Encino is a neighborhood located in the San Fernando Valley region of Los Angeles, California. Known for its affluent and upscale lifestyle, Encino is a popular residential area for families, professionals, and celebrities alike.

The neighborhood is characterized by its wide, tree-lined streets, sprawling estates, and manicured lawns. Many of the homes in Encino feature large, private lots and luxurious amenities such as swimming pools, tennis courts, and home theaters.

Encino is also home to several parks and green spaces, including the sprawling Encino Reservoir and the lush Encino Park. These areas provide ample opportunities for outdoor recreation, such as hiking, biking, and picnicking.

Encino has a bustling commercial district, with a variety of shops, restaurants, and businesses located along Ventura Boulevard, the main thoroughfare of the neighborhood. Here, residents can find everything from high-end boutiques and specialty stores to popular chain restaurants and cozy cafes.
Overall, Encino offers a tranquil and luxurious lifestyle, with a mix of natural beauty, urban convenience, and upscale amenities.

communities.description: Expert real estate services for SOCAL MLS | Michael Bergin is renowned for a multifaceted forte in working with sellers and buyers, whether it be new construction, home sales, short sales, finding your starter home or that perfect dream home.
body: Malibu is a beautiful coastal city located in Los Angeles County, California, United States. It is situated along the Pacific Ocean and is known for its stunning beaches, rugged coastline, and scenic mountain views. The city covers an area of approximately 19 square miles and has a population of approximately 12,000 residents as of 2021.

body.p: Before you start shopping for your property, it is a good idea to make some preparations.
A green file contains all your important financial documents. You will need it to secure financing for your property. The typical green file should contain:
Financial statements
Bank accounts
Investments
Credit cards
Auto loans
Recent pay stubs
Tax returns for two years
Copies of leases for investment properties
401K statements, life insurance, stocks, bonds, and mutual account information.

Your credit score will have a huge impact on what type of property you can buy, and at what price. It is first recommended to check your credit rating with an experienced lending institution so that we can determine what you can afford. The lender will research your credit ratings from the three credit reporting agencies Equifax, Experian and Trans Union. We will be happy to recommend experienced, knowledgeable lenders in the residential, construction, and commercial and investment real estate fields.
Now is not a good time to make sudden career changes or large purchases. You want to approach your property purchase from a position of financial stability.

steps.description: Expert real estate services for SOCAL MLS | Michael Bergin is renowned for a multifaceted forte in working with sellers and buyers, whether it be new construction, home sales, short sales, finding your starter home or that perfect dream home.

Does the agent return your calls promptly? Time is money when attempting to buy a property.

Choose an agent who listens attentively to your needs and concerns. Pick an agent, with whom you feel comfortable.

body.p: Once those preparations are out of the way, it is time to find the right property for you.

A good agent will investigate the potential costs and expenses associated with the new property. An agent can also help you draft your offer in a way that gives you the advantage over another offer.

steps.title: Escrow inspections & appraisals
steps.description: Expert real estate services for SOCAL MLS | Michael Bergin is renowned for a multifaceted forte in working with sellers and buyers, whether it be new construction, home sales, short sales, finding your starter home or that perfect dream home.

body.p: An effective agreement is a legal arrangement between a potential purchaser and the property’s seller.
Some important tips to keep in mind to streamline the process:

Keep written records of everything. For the sake of clarity, it will be extremely useful to transcribe all verbal agreements including counter-offers and addendums and to convert them into written agreements to be signed by both parties. We will assist you in drafting all the paperwork for your purchase and make sure that you have copies of everything.

Stick to the schedule. Now that you have chosen your offer, you and the seller will be given a timeline to mark every stage in the process of closing the real estate contract. Meeting the requirements on time ensures a smoother flow of negotiations so that each party involved is not in breach of their agreements. During the process we will keep you constantly updated, so you will always be prepared for the next step.

Either a title company or an attorney will be selected as a closing agent. The closing agent will hold the deposit in escrow and will research the complete recorded history of the property to ensure that the title is free and clear of encumbrances by the date of closing and that all new encumbrances are properly added to the title. Some properties are subject to restrictions which limit various activities such as building or parking restrictions. There may be recorded easements and encroachments, which limit the rights to use your property.

You may wish to consult an attorney or tax advisor on the best way to hold title. Different methods of holding title have different legal, estate and tax implications, especially when selling or upon death of the title holder.

Once your offer is accepted by the seller, you will need to have a licensed property inspector inspect the property within the time frame that was agreed upon in the effective contract to purchase. You may elect to have different inspectors inspect the property, if you wish to obtain professional opinions from inspectors who specialize in a specific area (eg. roof, HVAC, structure). If you are purchasing a commercial property, then you will need to have an environmental audit done on the site for the lending institution. We can recommend several different inspectors.
Depending on the outcome of these inspections, one of two things may happen:
1. Either each milestone is successfully closed and the contingencies will be removed, bringing you one step closer to the close, or
2. The buyer, after reviewing the property and the papers, requests a renegotiation of the terms of contract (usually the price).

It is imperative that you keep in close communication with your lender, who will let you know when additional documents are needed to approve your loan application and fund your loan. If the agreement is conditional upon financing, then the property will be appraised by a licensed appraiser to determine the value for the lending institution, via a third party. This is done so that the lending institution can confirm their investment in your property is accurate. Appraisers are specialists in determining the value of properties, based on a combination of square footage measurements, building costs, recent sales of comparable properties, operating income, etc. When you are within two weeks of closing, double check with your lender to be sure the loan will go through smoothly and on time.

If the property that you are purchasing is conditional upon an association approval, request the rules, regulations, and other important documents from the seller as soon as you have an effective agreement to purchase. Make sure that the application documents and processing fees are submitted to the appropriate person at the association by the required time. Fill out all of the information completely and legibly so there is no delay in processing the application. If you are required to meet with the association for your approval, make an appointment as soon as possible for the interview. Most associations require a certificate of approval before move-in. Your closing agent will request that the original copy of this approval letter be brought to the closing, so that it can be recorded with the deed in the county public records.

If you are obtaining a loan, you will be required by your lender to purchase a certain amount of insurance on the property. The value will depend on the lending institution and the purchase price of the property. You may be able to save hundreds of dollars a year on homeowners insurance by shopping around for insurance. You can also save money with these tips.
Consider a higher deductible. Increasing your deductible by just a few hundred dollars can make a big difference in your premium.

Ask your insurance agent about discounts. You may be able get a lower premium if your home has safety features such as dead-bolt locks, smoke detectors, an alarm system, storm shutters or fire-retardant roofing materials. Persons over 55 years of age or long-term customers may also be offered discounts.

Insure your house NOT the land under it. After a disaster, the land is still there. If you do not subtract the value of the land when deciding how much homeowner’s insurance to buy, you will pay more than you should.
We will be happy to recommend experienced knowledgeable insurance agents for every property type.

steps.title: Moving In
steps.description: Expert real estate services for SOCAL MLS | Michael Bergin is renowned for a multifaceted forte in working with sellers and buyers, whether it be new construction, home sales, short sales, finding your starter home or that perfect dream home.

body.p: If you have come this far, then this means that it is almost time for a congratulations, but not yet. Do not forget to tie up these loose ends:

More of a formality than anything else, the final inspection takes place a day before, or the day of the closing. You will visit the property to verify that all is in working order, everything is the same as when you last viewed the property, that there are no extra items left behind, and that everything included in your purchase is still at the property.
We will provide a list of useful numbers for the activation of home services and utilities after the closing occurs.

We are ready to assist you should an unforeseen glitch pop up, even at this last stage. Something at the property breaks down, or some other minor detail – no need to worry. We have encountered these problems before so we know how to handle them efficiently and in a stress-free manor.

The closing agent will furnish all parties involved with a settlement statement, which summarizes and details the financial transactions enacted in the process. You and the seller(s) will sign this statement, as well as the closing agent, certifying its accuracy. If you are obtaining financing, you will have to sign all pertinent documentation required by the lending institution. If you are unable to attend the scheduled closing, arrangements can be made depending on the circumstances and the notice that we receive. If you are bringing funds to the transaction, you can elect to either have the funds wired electronically into the closing agent’s escrow account, or bring a certified bank check to the closing in the amount specified on the settlement statement. The seller should arrange to have all property keys and any other important information for you at the closing so that you may receive these items at this time.

We will assist you in drafting all the paperwork for your sale and make sure that you have copies of everything.
Stick to the schedule.

Now that you have chosen your offer, you and the buyer will be given a timeline to mark every stage in the process of closing the real estate contract. Meeting the requirements on time ensures a smoother flow of negotiations and also ensures that each party involved is not in breach of their agreements. During the process we will keep you constantly updated so you will always be prepared for the next step.

steps.title: Escrow inspections & appraisals
steps.description: Expert real estate services for SOCAL MLS | Michael Bergin is renowned for a multifaceted forte in working with sellers and buyers, whether it be new construction, home sales, short sales, finding your starter home or that perfect dream home.

body.p: Most buyers will have the property inspected by a licensed property inspector within the time frame that was agreed upon in the effective contract to purchase. Some buyers will have several different inspectors inspect the property, if they wish to obtain professional opinions from inspectors who specialize in a specific area (eg. roof, HVAC, structure). If the agreement is conditional upon financing, then the property will be appraised by a licensed appraiser to determine the value for the lending institution via third party. This is done so that the lending institution can confirm their investment in your property is accurate. A buyer of a commercial property may also have a complete environmental audit performed and/or soil test, if required by the lending institution.

Either a title company or an attorney will be selected as the closing agent, whose job is to examine and insure clear title to real estate. After researching the complete recorded history of your property, they will certify that 1) your title is free and clear of encumbrances (eg. mortgages, leases, or restrictions, liens) by the date of closing; and 2) all new encumbrances are duly included in the title.

A contingency is a condition that must be met before a contract becomes legally binding. For instance, a buyer will usually include a contingency stating that their contract is binding only when there is a satisfactory home inspection report from a qualified inspector.
Before completing his or her purchase of your property, the buyer goes over every aspect of the property, as provided for by purchase agreements and any applicable addendums. These include:
Obtaining financing and insurance;
Reviewing all pertinent documents, such as preliminary title reports and disclosure documents; and

Inspecting the property. The buyer has the right to determine the condition of your property by subjecting it to a wide range of inspections, such as roof, termite/pest, chimney/fireplace, property boundary survey, well, septic, pool/spa, arborist, mold, lead based paint, HVAC, etc.
Depending on the outcome of these inspections, one of two things may happen:
Either each milestone is successfully closed and the contingencies will be removed, bringing you one step closer to the closing; or
The buyer, after reviewing the property and the papers, requests a renegotiation of the terms of contract (usually the price).

How do you respond objectively and fairly to the buyer when a renegotiation is demanded, while acting in your best interests? This is when a professional listing agent can make a real difference in the outcome of the transaction. Having dealt with various property sales in the past, we guarantee our expertise and total commitment to every customer, no matter what their situation is.

We suggest that you accept buyers who have a lender’s pre-approval, approval letter, or written loan commitment, which is a better guarantee of loan approval than a pre-qualification or no documentation from a lending institute. Expect an appraiser from the lender’s company to review your property and verify that the sales price is appropriate.

steps.title: Close of escrow
steps.description: Expert real estate services for SOCAL MLS | Michael Bergin is renowned for a multifaceted forte in working with sellers and buyers, whether it be new construction, home sales, short sales, finding your starter home or that perfect dream home.

body.p: If you have come this far, this means that it is almost time for a congratulations, but not yet. Do not forget to tie up these loose ends:

More of a formality than anything else, the final inspection takes place the day before, or the day of the closing. The buyer visits the property to verify that all is in working order, everything is the same as when the buyer last viewed the property, and that there are no extra items left behind.
We will provide a list of useful numbers for the termination of home services and utilities after the closing occurs.

We are ready to assist you should an unforeseen glitch pop up, even at this last stage. If something at the property breaks down or the buyers’ loan does not pull through on time, there is no need to worry. We have encountered these problems before so we know how to handle them efficiently and in a stress-free manner.

The closing agent will furnish all parties involved with a settlement statement, which summarizes and details the financial transactions enacted in the process. The buyer(s) will sign this statement and then you will sign as well as the closing agent, certifying its accuracy. If you are unable to attend the scheduled closing, then arrangements can be made depending on the circumstances and the notice that we receive. If you are receiving funds from the transaction, you can elect to either have the funds wired electronically to an account at your financial institution, or have a check issued to you at the closing. The seller should arrange to have all property keys and any other important information for the new purchaser at the closing, so that the purchaser may receive these items at this time.

intro.p: A Green File should contain all of your important financial documents. Regardless of the loan type, lenders will need information about you. Make copies of financial statements; bank accounts, investments, credit cards, auto loans, recent pay stubs and two years’ tax returns.
Credit scores range between 400 and 800. 620 + is considered “good”. 680 + is considered “premium” and may possibly help get you a lower interest rate.

Below you will find the contact information for the 3 major credit reporting agencies to help you determine your credit rating. Ask your lender how to improve your credit score if you need to. Going forward, treat your credit like gold.
Equifax
http://www.equifax.com
Experian
http://www.experian.com
Trans Union
http://www.transunion.com

If you are buying real estate, try to accumulate funds towards your down payment, closing costs (appraisal, miscellaneous fees, escrow, title insurance, etc.) and expenses such as inspections. Furthermore, try to pay down existing revolving and high interest rate debt like credit cards.

Now is not a good time to change careers, move your money around, or buy big ticket items. Lenders like stability. So if you are considering any major changes, it pays to meet with a lender and ask them how to proceed before you make any changes! If you are tempted to buy a big ticket item, consider the following:
A $500 a month debt payment (like a credit card or auto loan) could lower the amount of home you can afford by about $83,000! *
* Based on a 30 year mortgage at 6% interest.
